<title level="1" right="Class Feature 3">[Mystic Strikes](/Classes.aspx?ID=8)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 154

**Class** Monk
</column>

---

Focusing your will into your physical attacks imbues them with mystical energy. Your unarmed attacks become magical, allowing them to get past resistances to non-magical attacks. However, you still need an item such as [_handwraps of mighty blows_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=441) to gain an item bonus to attack rolls or increase your attacks' weapon damage dice.
name: Mystic Strikes
